title: An Action Song
text:
Today the class sings an action song. The song is about the body. Children touch their heads and then their feet.

The children jump and clap their hands. Then they stop and sit down. Everybody smiles at the end of the song.

questions.text: What do the children do after they clap?
How do the children feel at the end of the song?
Why do the children touch their heads and feet?

vocabulary.definition: all the parts of a person or animal
to hit your hands together to make a sound
makes a happy face with the mouth turned up

paragraph_translations: Hoje a turma canta uma música de ação. A música é sobre o corpo. As crianças tocam a cabeça e depois os pés.
As crianças pulam e batem palmas. Depois elas param e sentam. Todo mundo sorri no final da música.
